releases.summary: A restart-safe accessibility pulse that turns participant pace and audibility signals into recoverable receipts, live organiser guidance, and durable post-event evidence.

items.title: Shared restart-safe pulse ledger
items.description: Pace and audibility signals now use shared storage with latest-per-participant counts, recent activity, and retained trends that survive restarts and deployments.

items.title: Private participant pulse receipts
items.description: Participants receive a timestamped event-scoped receipt for their latest signal and can recover it on the same device without exposing a name, account, or raw session key.

items.title: Live accessibility response desk
items.description: Organisers see current needs, fifteen-minute activity, retained changes, and an immediate response recommendation for pace and audibility barriers.

items.title: Multilingual accessible signal recovery
items.description: Signal controls provide pressed state, mobile-size targets, translated recovery and privacy guidance, plus non-blocking failure and retry states in all five participant languages.

items.title: Post-event accessibility trend record
items.description: Visible and copied reports retain aggregate pulse counts and a timestamped trend so organisers can improve sound, pacing, and access at the next event.

releases.summary: Weekly blog guidance for preparing backup admins before peaceful events go live.

items.title: Backup admin readiness guide
items.description: A new weekly blog post helps organizers choose, brief, test, and coordinate backup admins so live event communication can continue if the primary organizer is busy or offline.

releases.summary: Weekly blog guidance for reviewing peaceful events and turning participant feedback into concrete improvements.

items.title: Post-event review questions guide
items.description: A new weekly blog post helps organizers review arrival flow, communication, accessibility, volunteer roles, and ChantLive records after a peaceful event.

releases.summary: A restart-safe crowd decision lifecycle that turns live polls into recoverable participant receipts, explicit organiser outcomes, and durable post-event records.

items.title: Restart-safe live poll ledger
items.description: Poll questions, options, event-scoped anonymous votes, and one-open-poll rules now survive reconnects, restarts, and deployments.

items.title: Private participant vote receipts
items.description: Participants can recover or change their own selection while a poll is open without exposing a name, account, device, or raw session key.

items.title: Organiser decision close workflow
items.description: The live controller must select the recorded outcome and can add a rationale before closing a poll and moving to the next decision.

items.title: Multilingual participant decisions
items.description: Participants see the final outcome, organiser rationale, and recovered private receipt after reconnecting in English, Spanish, French, Arabic, or Persian.

items.title: Post-event crowd decision record
items.description: The event report now preserves poll history, aggregate totals, selected outcomes, and rationales while excluding participant hashes.

releases.summary: Weekly blog guidance for backup communication when mobile signal is unreliable at peaceful events.

items.title: Weak-signal backup communication guide
items.description: A new weekly blog post helps organizers define essential messages, pair one digital path with one physical fallback, brief relay volunteers, and use ChantLive as one layer in weak-signal conditions.

releases.summary: A restart-safe anonymous Q&A lifecycle that lets participants privately track questions while organisers spotlight, answer, moderate, and review them end to end.

items.title: Durable anonymous questions and votes
items.description: Questions and one-vote-per-device signals now use shared event-scoped storage, stay idempotent across repeat taps, and survive reconnects, restarts, and multi-instance deployments without storing participant identities.

items.title: Private participant question receipts
items.description: Participants can see the status of questions submitted from their device, follow published answers, and withdraw their own still-open question through a deliberate two-step mobile control.

items.title: Live organiser Q&A desk
items.description: The active controller can spotlight one question, compose and publish an answer, dismiss inappropriate submissions, and recover loading or network failures from an accessible Command Center queue.

items.title: Multilingual live and published answers
items.description: Participant screens now announce the question being answered and its published response in English, Spanish, French, Arabic, and Persian, with socket updates and reload recovery.

items.title: Post-event Q&A outcomes report
items.description: Printable and copied event reports now retain question totals, votes, answer rate, moderation outcomes, and published responses while excluding device hashes and withdrawn content.

releases.summary: Privacy-safe event registration that lets communities plan capacity, run a fair waitlist, and compare RSVPs with real attendance without collecting identities.

items.title: Optional organiser RSVP settings
items.description: Organisers can enable anonymous registration per event, set capacity and a closing time, and close or reopen reservations from the Command Center without changing events that do not need registration.

items.title: Anonymous participant reservation
items.description: Participants can reserve or cancel one place from the event page in five languages without providing an account, name, email address, or phone number.

items.title: Fair automatic capacity waitlist
items.description: Capacity is enforced transactionally, repeat taps stay idempotent, and the oldest waiting reservation is promoted automatically when a confirmed place opens or capacity increases.

items.title: Live organiser capacity desk
items.description: The Command Center now shows confirmed, waiting, available, over-capacity, and confirmed-attendee turnout states with accessible controls and automatic updates during event preparation.

items.title: Restart-safe RSVP reporting
items.description: Private device receipts survive restarts and post-event reports compare confirmed RSVPs with aggregate attendance using only event-scoped anonymous hashes, never a participant roster.

releases.summary: A privacy-safe attendance journey that shows organisers who joined, returned, and stayed while giving every participant a transparent, erasable receipt.

items.title: Durable anonymous visit ledger
items.description: Event-scoped session hashes now retain join, last-seen, disconnect, reconnect, and observed-time evidence through application restarts without storing IP address, device, location, account, or participant content.

items.title: Live organiser attendance journey
items.description: The Command Center now shows live viewers, unique participants, visits, returning people, reconnects, peak concurrency, observed time, and hourly arrivals with loading, empty, and recovery states.

items.title: Post-event attendance report
items.description: Printable and copied debrief reports retain aggregate attendance and arrival evidence after the crowd disconnects, replacing the previous point-in-time viewer snapshot.

items.title: Participant-owned attendance receipt
items.description: Participants can inspect their own first join, visits, last-seen time, and observed connection time in all five interface languages, then erase the event record and opt out from an accessible mobile control.

items.title: Restart-safe attendance recovery
items.description: Connection heartbeats preserve observed time, reconnects add visits without double-counting a person, receipt updates resume automatically, and opting out prevents the active device from being recorded again.

releases.summary: Self-healing production continuity that keeps ChantLive reachable, explains degraded live data, and verifies recovery through the public edge.

items.title: Always-reachable service with safe readiness gates
items.description: A database outage no longer prevents the ChantLive web shell from starting; liveness stays available while data-dependent actions pause with explicit 503 recovery responses.

items.title: Public service status and recovery banner
items.description: Visitors can open an accessible status centre, retry checks, and see a global degraded or recovered message instead of an unexplained failure.

items.title: Role-specific event recovery guidance
items.description: Organisers receive an always-visible readiness card, while participant screens warn that the last chant is stale and direct people back to rehearsed safety instructions during recovery.

items.title: Bounded database and web-service recovery
items.description: Production deployment now recovers a failed local PostgreSQL service before touching schema or app state and installs a controlled app restart policy with actionable diagnostics.

items.title: Public-edge deployment certification and watchdog
items.description: Deployments must remain ready through repeated public checks, and a five-minute watchdog can restart the local database and app after a confirmed sustained outage.

releases.summary: Reusable event programme templates that carry a proven organiser plan into new events and give participants the complete public sequence.

items.title: Field-ready programme starter library
items.description: Organisers can begin with complete march, vigil, prayer-circle, or community-gathering programmes instead of rebuilding every stage by hand.

items.title: Previewed replace and append workflow
items.description: Template previews show every stage, planned duration, and exact replace or append impact before an atomic draft-only update, with started-event and size-limit protection.

items.title: Personal reusable programme templates
items.description: An organiser can save any current event programme to a private PostgreSQL-backed library and reuse its public stages, guidance, types, and planned timing on future events.

items.title: Private template ownership and management
items.description: Saved programmes show stage and duration details, remain isolated to their owner, and use a confirmed deletion flow that never changes events which already used them.

items.title: Accessible participant full-programme view
items.description: Participants can expand the complete public sequence with localized status, guidance, and planned timing on mobile, including right-to-left layouts and a 44px language control.

releases.summary: A restart-safe live event run sheet that keeps organisers and participants aligned from arrival through closing.

items.title: Event run-sheet composer
items.description: Organisers can build a complete event sequence from arrival, welcome, chant, speaker, movement, break, closing, or custom stages with participant guidance and planned duration.

items.title: Timed operational readiness plan
items.description: The Command Center shows total planned time, scheduled start estimates, validation and empty states, plus safe reordering and removal before the sequence begins.

items.title: Accountable live stage progression
items.description: The authorised live operator can start, complete and advance, skip, or reopen stages while transactional PostgreSQL state prevents conflicting active stages and survives deployments.

items.title: Participant Now and Next programme
items.description: Participants receive an accessible mobile event-progress panel with the current stage, participant guidance, planned time, and next stage in all five interface languages after live updates or reconnection.

items.title: Post-event delivery timeline
items.description: Post-event reports compare planned stages with completed, skipped, pending, and actual-duration outcomes in both the visible report and copied debrief text.

releases.summary: Weekly blog guidance for writing chants that peaceful event participants can follow quickly.

items.title: Easy-to-follow chant writing guide
items.description: A new weekly blog post helps organizers write short, clear, accessible call-and-response chants, test them with real people, and use ChantLive to keep participants together.

releases.summary: A private participant-to-organiser conduct response workflow for reporting, triage, follow-up, and safer post-event learning.

items.title: Private participant conduct reporting
items.description: Participants can confidentially report harassment, unsafe behaviour, privacy concerns, harmful misinformation, or another concern with an urgency level and clear emergency boundaries.

items.title: Durable privacy-safe concern ledger
items.description: Validated reports are stored without participant accounts or requested identity details, survive server restarts, and safely return an existing receipt for a matching open submission.

items.title: Organiser moderation desk
items.description: Verified event organisers can prioritise urgent concerns, filter the private queue, acknowledge reports, send a private response, resolve them, and reopen follow-up when needed.

items.title: Private participant receipts and recovery
items.description: Each participant receives a reference and can privately recover only their own sent, seen, resolved, and organiser-response status after reload or reconnection in all five interface languages.

items.title: Privacy-preserving conduct response summary
items.description: Post-event reports show category, urgency, status, acknowledgement, and resolution trends while deliberately excluding sensitive participant report text and private organiser replies.

releases.summary: One accountable live operator can safely hand event control between organiser devices without conflicting participant updates.

items.title: Automatic launch ownership

items.title: Live control handoff desk
items.description: The Command Center identifies the operator and lets them hand control to another verified event admin or release it cleanly.

items.title: Server-protected live commands
items.description: Chants, announcements, polls, incidents, help resolution, timing, and event-ending commands now reject conflicting non-operator changes.

items.title: Read-only collaborator mode
items.description: Other admins can monitor live readiness and participant responses while risky controls stay visibly locked on their device.

items.title: Owner device-loss recovery

releases.summary: Restart-safe live incident continuity for organisers and participants during deployments and outages.

items.title: Durable shared incident ledger

items.title: Atomic incident lifecycle

items.title: Restart-safe participant help queue

items.title: Organiser continuity and incident history

items.title: Private participant response recovery

releases.summary: A complete organiser-to-participant incident response and all-clear workflow for live disruptions.

items.title: Field-ready incident starters

items.title: Structured live incident state

items.title: Prominent participant incident response
items.description: Connected participants immediately see an accessible multilingual incident banner on the main event screen and can report OK, need help, leaving, or uncertainty without opening Help.

items.title: Real-time incident accountability

items.title: Visible all-clear and reconnection recovery

releases.summary: Opt-in offline participation for events where mobile signal cannot be trusted.

items.title: Offline-capable participant app
items.description: A prepared ChantLive page can reopen its production app shell without a network connection, while API, authentication, and live Socket.IO responses are never cached.

items.title: Save an event for weak signal

items.title: Latest verified chant after an offline reload
items.description: Prepared devices restore the most recently received event and chant when the live connection cannot be reached, and keep the saved copy current while online updates arrive.

items.title: Clear offline safety and privacy controls
items.description: A prominent timestamped warning distinguishes saved information from live instructions, with reconnect and forget actions plus a clear device-only privacy explanation in every supported language.

items.title: Organiser low-signal rehearsal workflow

releases.summary: A safe end-to-end workflow for turning a proven event into a fresh future draft.

items.title: Repeat any event from the dashboard
items.description: Organisers can start a new edition from any draft, live, or ended event without exporting, importing, or rebuilding it by hand.

items.title: Clear repeat-event choices
items.description: A focused dialog validates the new title and schedule while letting organisers choose whether to bring chants, logistics, and the support link forward.

items.title: All-or-nothing event copying
items.description: Selected event content and timing are copied together in one server transaction so organisers never land in a half-built repeated event.

items.title: Fresh participant access and live state
items.description: Every repeated event gets a new participant code and resets live status, the current chant, automation, participant activity, feedback, questions, polls, safety reports, and admin access.

items.title: Review, rehearse, and invite handoff

releases.summary: A consistent multilingual invitation workflow across organiser tools.

items.title: Remembered invitation language

items.title: Multilingual editor invitations

items.title: Share Kit language control

items.title: Localized arrival and calendar messages

items.title: Readable multilingual access fallback

releases.summary: Localized organiser invitations and clearer live connection recovery.

items.title: Invitation language selector
items.description: Organisers can prepare complete participant invitations in English, Spanish, French, Arabic, or Persian directly from the dashboard.

items.title: Mobile dashboard invitation sharing
items.description: Dashboard event cards can send the selected-language invitation through the device share sheet, with clipboard and selectable-text fallbacks.

items.title: Last-received chant guidance
items.description: If a live connection drops, participants now see a prominent translated warning that the words on screen are the last update received.

items.title: One-tap live reconnection
items.description: The live connection warning includes a 44px-or-larger translated reconnect action so participants can recover without opening the Help panel.

items.title: Join another event after ending

releases.summary: Clearer event-day logistics and more useful participant recovery.

items.title: Complete dashboard logistics
items.description: Organiser event cards now show the saved meeting point and arrival guidance alongside the venue and schedule for faster event-day checks.

items.title: Dashboard event directions
items.description: Organisers can open directions to the saved venue and meeting point directly from an event card.

items.title: Arrival-ready calendar invites
items.description: Participant calendar entries now preserve the meeting point, arrival guidance, directions, participant link, and event code in the selected language.

items.title: Localized participant recovery checklist
items.description: A failed join now gives participants a short, translated checklist for checking the code, reopening the original link, and confirming availability with the organiser.

items.title: Organiser-ready recovery details
items.description: Participants can copy the localized failure, checked code, and attempted link together, with a selectable on-screen fallback when clipboard access is blocked.

releases.summary: More resilient mobile sharing and faster organiser event checks.

items.title: Touch-friendly dropdown choices
items.description: Calendar, sorting, and other dropdown choices now provide dependable 44px-or-larger tap targets across participant and organiser workflows.

items.title: Dashboard participant preview
items.description: Organisers can open the participant view directly from an event card to check the attendee experience before sharing.

items.title: Clipboard-blocked organiser fallback

items.title: Arrival-ready participant invitations
items.description: Participant sharing now includes one-tap directions and selected-language reassurance that no account or QR scanner is required.

items.title: Manual participant sharing fallback
items.description: When both device sharing and clipboard access are unavailable, participants can select and copy the complete localized invitation without losing event details.

releases.summary: More accessible participant logistics and faster organiser invitations.

items.title: Touch-friendly participant controls
items.description: Join fields, language controls, sharing actions, and connection-recovery controls now provide dependable 44px-or-larger tap targets.

items.title: Complete participant sharing
items.description: Participant sharing now includes the selected-language event time, venue, meeting point, and arrival guidance alongside the link and code.

items.title: One-tap event directions
items.description: Participants can open directions from waiting, live, and ended event-detail panels without retyping the venue or meeting point.

items.title: Keyboard-operable event cards
items.description: Organisers can focus a dashboard event card and open its setup with Enter or Space, with a clear focus indicator and accessible name.

items.title: Dashboard complete invitations
items.description: Each organiser event card can copy a ready-to-send invitation containing the participant link, short code, saved logistics, and no-account reassurance.

releases.summary: Safer participant return visits and faster mobile sharing for organisers.

items.title: Larger core touch targets
items.description: Primary actions, compact controls, and icon buttons now meet a more dependable mobile tap size across participant and organiser journeys.

items.title: Recent event age guidance
items.description: Returning participants can see when they last joined a saved event and receive a warning before using an older shortcut.

items.title: Unavailable shortcut recovery
items.description: A confirmed missing event is removed from the saved recent-event shortcut, preventing participants from returning to the same dead link.

items.title: Searchable organiser share kit
items.description: Organisers can filter copy-ready messages by purpose, audience, or content to find participant, safety, volunteer, and recovery scripts quickly.

items.title: Resilient share-kit sending
items.description: Every organiser message has a one-tap Share action with copy fallback and clear recovery guidance when device sharing or clipboard access is unavailable.

releases.summary: Faster participant return visits and complete, resilient organiser invitations.

items.title: Recent event shortcut
items.description: After successfully joining, participants can return from the landing page with one tap instead of finding the invitation again, with an option to forget the event on that device.

items.title: Keyboard-first joining

items.title: Complete event-detail invitations

items.title: Mobile invitation sharing

items.title: Clipboard-blocked invitation fallback

releases.summary: Weekly blog guidance for preparing permit questions before peaceful demonstrations.

items.title: Permit preparation questions guide

items.title: Labelled event-code joining

items.title: Punctuation-tolerant event codes
items.description: A valid event code copied with surrounding quotes or sentence punctuation is now accepted instead of showing a false validation error.

items.title: Failed-code correction
items.description: Returning from a failed participant link now prefills the checked code so one-character mistakes are easier to correct.

items.title: Focused join recovery
items.description: The recovery path focuses and selects the join field, with clear guidance for keyboard and screen-reader users.

items.title: One-tap complete invitation
items.description: Organisers can copy one ready-to-send invitation containing the event name, labelled short code, plain participant link, and no-account/no-scanner reassurance.

items.title: Event creation confirmation

items.title: Link-and-code-first access panel

items.title: Copyable failed event code
